model.name: R18.23: Browse-File link carries LINE information so the Monaco editor opens at the correct line.
model.description:
## LITERAL SOURCE — Follow-on C: Detail-view full-methods + Parent/Browse-File links (2026-06-05)

> TRON: "on this picture we see the beautiful traceability. BUT on the details view, i want to see ALL methods, not just the traced one. the same on the ScenarioView. for all types. above the scenario view link i want a 'Parent' link. and below it i want to see a Browse File Link, that jumps to the corresponding file in the Browser. there i can open it in the monacco editor. add line information to the link, so that eg on a method or usecase the monacco editor can open at the correct line"

### Decomposition hints (req: confirm against literal)
- R18.12 [→ R18.23]: The Browse-File link carries LINE information so the Monaco editor opens at the correct line (e.g. a Method or UseCase opens at its source line).

Note: Source decomposition draft used the preliminary label "R18.12" which collides with the already-numbered R18.12 (true-cycle nodes omitted cleanly) at line 175. The gap-filler renumbered this to R18.23. See also R18.15 (Follow-on D, line 337) which REVISES this: line carries through browser→editor (target = browser-with-highlight, line preserved end-to-end).

**Acceptance criteria :**
- [ ] Browse-File link URL includes line-number parameter
- [ ] For Method targets: line = method's declaration line in .ts source
- [ ] For UseCase targets: line = UseCase's line in .puml file
- [ ] Line survives browser → Monaco editor transition (per R18.15 revision)
- [ ] Monaco editor opens at the correct line when user clicks through
